# SK2002 — A pure method's result is discarded

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

A bare call discards the result of a method marked System.Diagnostics.Contracts.Pure or a known immutable string transformation.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Correctness |
| Default severity | warning |
| Scope | Semantic |
| Needs a compilation | yes |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 2.0 |

## Why

Pure calls do not update their receiver. Discarding the returned string or calculation often leaves the input unchanged where a normalization or assignment was intended.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
value.Trim();
```

Write:

```csharp
value = value.Trim();
```

## When it does not fire

Only method-level framework PureAttribute contracts and a closed set of System.String transformations are recognized. Arbitrary methods, lookalike attributes and void calls are ignored. Assignment to a discard, storage, return and other consumption are explicit choices. Bare expression statements only; no fix can decide which value should receive the result.

## Configuration

- `dotnet_diagnostic.SK2002.severity`
